title: Future Me Called Two Minutes Before MIDNIGHT 🕛
description:
On your thirtieth birthday, your phone rings once, and it's you, calling from later. Everybody else's call came by breakfast.

By 11:57 that night, mine still hadn't. My mom and I sat at her kitchen table, under fourteen clocks, and waited.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Was future me late or early? Check Mom's clocks before you answer.
